research_addendum.note: Development results on the 2021 validation split, not the 334-screen public test. Neither experiment established an improvement and neither model is promoted.

20260928_experiment_D.title: Gene-level LambdaRank over 57 historical-context features
20260928_experiment_D.comparison: Published frontier ensemble on the same 218 screens: 0.186437. Paired difference -0.005452, 95% publication-cluster interval [-0.016147, +0.010805] over 10,000 resamples.
20260928_experiment_D.finding: No improvement established: the interval contains zero and the point estimate is below the ensemble. Selection multiplicity 14.

20260928_experiment_E.title: Requested-effect polarity conditioning
20260928_experiment_E.comparison: Cross-validation selected the unconditioned baseline. The polarity prior scored -0.007931 [-0.023172, +0.004531] against it; the polarity-plus-transfer variant -0.010680 [-0.024030, +0.001069].
20260928_experiment_E.finding: The parser separates all 47 metadata-matched increase/decrease comparisons that previous features collapsed. That is a representation improvement, not an established ranking improvement.

post_screen.benchmark: SplicR cross-screen replication benchmark: 124 held-out screen pairs from different publications, first authors and libraries, same cell line, unperturbed proliferation
post_screen.note: Given a screen a lab has already run, rank its candidates by how likely each is to be called a hit in an independent screen. This is a different task from the pre-screen prediction table and the two are not comparable.
limitations: Cross-screen replication is a proxy for reproducibility, not proof that a candidate passes an independent biological validation assay.
The target screen's hit call depends on its own significance criteria; a real effect can fail to replicate because that threshold was stricter.
113 of the 124 held-out pairs are one library comparison (Behan 2019 against Meyers 2017); the 11 remaining pairs are reported separately.
Unperturbed proliferation screens only. Nothing is established for drug-modifier, host-pathogen or reporter screens.
This is a ranking, not a calibrated probability that any individual gene validates.
